title: The Copilot+ PC brand is dead
summary: Microsoft and PC manufacturers are quietly abandoning the Copilot+ PC branding that was introduced to market Windows 11 AI-powered computers, as the initiative failed to resonate with consumers and became associated with underwhelming AI features.
problem_solved: Reports on why Microsoft's Copilot+ PC branding campaign failed to gain traction in the market despite heavy marketing push.
why_valuable: Provides insight into how tech companies pivot when branding initiatives fail and signals shifts in the AI PC market strategy.
